0022600184.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak and 2-1 on the road) visit the San Antonio Spurs (4-2, on a four-game winning streak and 2-2 at home), with Dallas 7th in the West and fourth in the Southwest, two games back, and San Antonio 6th in the West and third in the Southwest, also two games back. The Mavericks trail the season series 0-1 after losing 122-106 in Dallas, and they lost all four meetings in 2025-26. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Max Christie listed as day-to-day with a hip injury and a game-time decision, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
